title: Split-flap output element
blurb: A departure board of six <output> elements. A form sets their values and the canvas flips each changed character, through the alphabet or straight from a snapshot of the old picture to the new one.
question: Can a canvas turn a change of output.value into a split-flap flip for each character, using only the paint event to learn about the change?
result: Yes. Setting the value fires paint. The nine-argument drawElementImage() draws single characters from a hidden drum element or from a snapshot of the old board.
